name: Marvin
description: Monitors stock tickers, analyzes trends, and assists with trading decisions via yfinance.

precondition.reason: Threshold checks need fresh post-market data from the yfinance tool, so the scan always runs.

prompt: Review the tickers in pkm/wallet/stock/portfolio.md and pkm/wallet/stock/watchlist.md.
Following your market_data skill, call the yfinance tool once (action=quote) with all tickers, then apply the skill's Threshold Rule.
For Triggered tickers only, optionally drill down with yfinance history/earnings, then perform a web_search for news/macro/earnings.
Save a markdown report for each Triggered ticker under pkm/wallet/stock/{SYMBOL}.md and reply with the skill's triage table.
